overview.wCash: You need ~{{amount}} in cash (equity + 6% operating reserve). Subsidy typically disburses over months — plan working capital.
overview.wPpa: PPA tariff and banking rules change by DISCOM order — validate the latest tariff schedule before signing.
overview.wTx: Transformer / HT equipment lead times can be 3–9 months — start procurement early.
overview.wDust: Soiling losses are real — budget robots or manual cleaning; inland states see higher dust.

costs.landFree: ₹0 — psychological anchor; you already own the land.
costs.subsidyDelay: Subsidy disbursement in practice is often 4–9 months after milestones — do not model 30–60 days.
costs.reserve: Keep the 6% operating reserve aside for commissioning, LDC charges, and initial O&M spikes.
costs.gst: GST on solar plant typically ~5% (consult your CA).
costs.ad: Accelerated depreciation may apply for business structures — not personal farming income in all cases.
costs.rec: RECs / other incentives depend on scheme registration and DISCOM.
costs.nabard: NABARD / cooperative refinancing may offer competitive rates for eligible groups.

model.note: Year 11 is often the inflection point: loan EMI ends and net cash rises sharply — verify O&M and tariff assumptions annually.

risks.title: Risk / Impact / Mitigation
risks.r1i: ₹5–15L+ working capital stress in first 18 months
risks.r1m: Stage drawdowns with bank; keep 6% reserve; track nodal agency queue.
risks.r2m: Model mid-tariff; add sensitivity −₹0.20/unit; legal review of PPA.
risks.r3m: Pre-check 33/132 kV availability; get budgetary quote from DISCOM.
risks.r4m: Cleaning robot or contract; monitor PR monthly.
risks.r5m: Order early; keep alternate make list; align EPC schedule.
risks.r6m: ALMM-only modules; milestone payments; LD clauses.
risks.r7m: Verify 7/12, access road, and agrivoltaics height rules early.
risks.r8m: OEM SLA contract; spare FOC list; remote monitoring.

action.title: Phased action plan
action.p1a: Call {{nodal}} helpline and confirm latest PM-KUSUM checklist for {{state}}.
action.p1b: Visit DISCOM ({{discom}}) website and download application pack.
action.p1c: Shortlist 2 ALMM-compliant EPC quotes with milestone payment terms.
action.p2a: Land documents: 7/12, khata, consent co-owners, bank NOC if mortgaged.
action.p2b: Apply for technical feasibility / load study at DISCOM.
action.p3a: Finalize single-line diagram and plant layout with EPC.
action.p3b: Open dedicated project bank account if required by lender.
action.p4a: Submit GEDA / nodal registration with benchmark cost compliance.
action.p4b: Initiate module + inverter procurement (long lead items).
action.p5b: HT equipment installation; DISCOM inspection scheduling.
action.p6a: Commissioning, sync, and trial run; SCADA handover.
action.p6b: COD certificate; subsidy claim pack; LDC activation.
action.bank: SBI Agri / branch — Kisan Solar Energy Loan (verify current circular).

agri.title: Agrivoltaics (indicative)
agri.l1: Interspace — standard row spacing, crops between rows
agri.l2: Stilt 2.5 m — mechanised farming under array
agri.l3: High stilt 4–5 m — tree / high-value crops; higher capex
agri.cropsGj: Cotton, groundnut, cumin, fodder; horticulture with drip.
agri.cropsRj: Pearl millet, moth bean, guar; medicinal herbs in trials.
agri.cropsDef: Seasonal vegetables, pulses, oilseeds — match local mandi demand.
agri.incomeNote: ₹20k–80k / acre / year highly variable — depends on crop, water, and market.
agri.capexNote: Stilt structures can add ₹0.3–0.8 Cr / MW depending on height and wind zone.
agri.ph1: Phase 1: pilot 1–2 acres interspace with low shade crop.
agri.ph2: Phase 2: expand after PR validation and irrigation plan.
agri.ph3: Phase 3: mechanisation / stilt only if economics and NA rules allow.
agri.na: NA conversion can derail timelines — prefer layouts permitted under current land class and local circulars.

footer.disclaimer: Estimates only — not financial advice. Tariffs, subsidies, and DISCOM rules change; verify with nodal agency and a qualified consultant before investing.
